import copy
import json
from pathlib import Path
from api import list_labels

rows = json.loads(Path('state/records.json').read_text())
release = json.loads(Path('state/release.json').read_text())
print('Snapshot:', release['snapshot_id'], 'migration:', release['migration'])
cases = [
    ('legacy', [rows[0]], ['Alpha']),
    ('object', [rows[1]], ['Beta']),
    ('mixed snapshot', rows, ['Alpha', 'Beta']),
    ('mixed reversed', list(reversed(rows)), ['Beta', 'Alpha']),
    ('empty list', [], []),
    ('object text/order', [{'label': {'text': text}} for text in ['Beta', '', ' Å ', 'Beta']], ['Beta', '', ' Å ', 'Beta']),
]
failed = 0
for name, records, expected in cases:
    before = copy.deepcopy(records)
    try:
        actual = list_labels(records)
    except Exception as exc:
        failed += 1
        print(f'FAIL {name}: expected {expected"'!r}; raised {type(exc).__name__}: {exc}; input_unchanged={records == before}'"')
    else:
        passed = actual == expected and records == before
        failed += not passed
        print(f'{\"PASS\" if passed else \"FAIL\"} {name}: expected {expected"'!r}; actual {actual!r}; input_unchanged={records == before}'"')
print(f'{len(cases)} scenarios: {len(cases)-failed} passed, {failed} failed')
raise SystemExit(bool(failed))
